articles.headline: Major tech companies call for a defensive surge to defeat AI-driven hacks
articles.summary: OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, Alphabet, and Amazon backed a society-wide push to strengthen defenses against AI-enabled hacking. For businesses, this raises the urgency of upgrading security controls, employee training, and incident response as attackers gain better automation tools.

articles.headline: More than 100 companies sign AI cyber defense letter
articles.summary: More than 100 companies and entities, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and AMD, signed a call for businesses and policymakers to prioritize cybersecurity in the age of AI. The message signals that cybersecurity spending and governance are becoming board-level business issues, not just IT concerns.

articles.headline: Federal judge orders Pentagon to remove Anthropic supply-chain risk label
articles.summary: A court ruling removes a Pentagon designation that had labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, reducing a potential compliance and procurement obstacle for enterprises and government buyers. The decision matters for companies using frontier AI because it lowers immediate uncertainty around vendor approval and contract risk.
